tool_args.rationale: The pilot rows show positive short-window gain, while the authorized mechanism notes specify a dual-horizon reversal at H≈15–25. Since the forecast target H=21.9 lies in that reversal regime and current rows cover only H≤0.48, acquire the slow-horizon discriminating probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential reversal law using only the five short-horizon rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations are at H ≤ 0.48, far below the target horizon 21.9; the slow component and long-horizon reversal are not identified well enough for confirmation.
More short-horizon samples would not discriminate the long-horizon reversal behavior.
It is unrelated to the identified horizon ambiguity and is not justified.
